newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Saab Auto to launch new 9-5 model in June.
newsitem.headline: Saab Auto to launch new 9-5 model in June.

text.p: Swedish car maker Saab Auto said on Thursday that it would present its new 9-5 model in June 1997, stopping production of the Saab 9000 series after the new model is launched.

"Saab 9-5 will be presented to international media in June in Trollhattan (Sweden) and sales will start in September on certain markets," Jan-Ake Jonsson, head of the company's business unit 9000/9-5, told a news conference.
"The car will also be shown at the car fair in Frankfurt in September."
The production of the Saab 9000 CD will cease when Saab 9-5 is launched, he said.
"The introduction of the new Saab 9-5 adds a model at the top of Saab's model series," Jonsson said.
"In the future most markets will also include the Saab 9000 CS and Saab 900."
He added that the company's next new model will be in the Saab 9-5 series and will be a station wagon.
